name: Gargantuan Tumor
summary: In Teldrassil, a great growth was cut from Oakenscowl near Lake Al'Ameth. Its blight marks the sickness spreading among the creatures there.

sections.title: Blight Upon the Lake
sections.body:
Oakenscowl lurks in a cavern near the southern bank of Lake Al'Ameth. Once a noble timberling elder, it has fallen to a vile affliction. A huge growth poisoned Oakenscowl and warped its behavior. The tumor also spread taint through the surrounding wildlife.

The growth was severed to end Oakenscowl's rampage and give local researchers a chance to study the blight. They hope to learn how the malady took root in the boughs of the newly grown World Tree.

faq.q: Where does the Gargantuan Tumor come from?
faq.answer: The Gargantuan Tumor comes from Oakenscowl, a large corrupted timberling in a cave on Lake Al'Ameth's southern shore in Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is causing the tumor to grow on Oakenscowl?
aliases: why does oakenscowl have a tumor
faq.answer: The tumor marks the strange corruption poisoning timberlings and wildlife around Lake Al'Ameth. Oakenscowl was once a grand leader of its kind, but the growth overcame it.

faq.q: Who wants to study this tumor?
faq.answer: Local investigators want to study the tumor and learn how to treat or halt the strange rot afflicting timberlings nearby.

angles.text: As a druid tending Teldrassil's young boughs, you can see how vulnerable nature there is to corruption in the tumor.
As a night elf, you see a respected elder timberling reduced to a mad, blighted monster, a sign of the troubles facing your new homeland.
